title: On the zero sets of the Bargmann Fock space
summary: At the critical density, the classical density theory of the Bargmann--Fock space no longer determines exact zero sets. We show that this failure is substantial: the complete radial counting function together with any prescribed finite collection of angular moments does not determine exact realizability, and the finite-dimensional relation between the dimension of the vanishing space and the zero-insertion capacity breaks down in infinite dimension.
